question: To whom did President Droupadi Murmu confer the 58th Jnanpith Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and Gulzar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu conferred the 58th Jnanpith Award to Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and Gulzar for their exceptional contributions to literature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and Gulzar were honored with the 58th Jnanpith Award for their significant contributions to Indian literature.**
 
• Gulzar was unable to attend the ceremony due to health reasons, but both laureates were praised by the President for their impact on literary heritage.
 
• The President emphasized the role of literature in uniting society and its importance in shaping national identity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Jnanpith Award__

 __
 
• India's highest literary honor, given annually for exceptional contributions to literature.
 
• Recognizes writers for their outstanding works in any Indian language.
 
 
 
• Jagadguru Rambhadracharya__
 __
 
• Famous for his work in philosophy, literature, and his role as a spiritual leader.
 
 
 
• Gulzar__
 
 
• A renowned poet, lyricist, and filmmaker, known for his contributions to Hindi literature and cinema.
